scope: CareMate live-only phone monitor and authenticated MJPEG input
windows_bat_from_unrelated_directory: --help passed without loading model or opening camera/browser
checks: Authenticated MJPEG input and HTML live-image discovery on loopback
Same-origin image selection without reading logo or archive links
Snapshot and ambiguous/external page references rejected
Separate startup and ordinary frame wait budgets
Safe Chinese login and stream diagnostics without credential exposure
Old sequence requests return only the current frame; stale frames refused
Hidden or restored monitor page discards pending old responses and jumps to current frame
field_acceptance: Pending user launch with iPhone credentials. Does not establish real camera or end-to-end notification success.
limitations: Automatic homepage discovery requires an explicit unambiguous same-origin img src returning MJPEG; JavaScript-only players and RTSP require separate handling.
